work.author: PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA
work.description: The act condemns the Piedmontese suppression of religious houses. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF154-158) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF25932-25933 reads: HABITA IN CONSISTORIO SECRETO DIE XXT1 IVLII MDCCCLY. Date note: Edition dated caption Habita in consistorio ..., retained in the selection; it is the only printed dating of the speech. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
